title: Fuel Prices Force Airline Cutbacks, American's Basic Economy Backfires, and Etihad's A380 Finally Comes Home
summary: Fuel prices spike thanks to the Iran situation, and suddenly American, United, and Southwest are all quietly cutting flights instead of adding them. Plus, American admits it may have gone too far with Basic Economy, Etihad finally reactivates its last grounded A380 after six and a half years, and yes, we have to talk about the dog on the Southwest flight.
